what: Fresh-consumer verification of the cpcb-aqi-exceedance v2026.11 private release (artifact a749f0df2f9dd0103d0ba56524e1cc3638242fbc4710b0cac99603bcdef0d959): the worker host fetches the five released assets from earino/cpcb-aqi-exceedance release 436366305 with digest verification (the container holds no credential), then the container runs every published REPRODUCE.md step against the released bytes - package-vs-MANIFEST check, get_dataset.py verification, sha256sum -c, gate 1.5.0 re-run on the full artifact, exact-byte --accept against the shipped qualification.json, declared dependency imports, baseline reproduce (both AUC prints 0.9734, CONTRACT OK, holdout never copied into a workdir), score.py references recomputed equal to measurements.json - and additionally recomputes the pre-registered deciding check REPRODUCE.md says recomputation must reproduce (model-minus-persistence [0.0038, 0.0052], model-minus-climatology [0.1002, 0.1252]) from the released bytes through the shipped baseline/train.py and code/score.py, never reimplemented. The optional rebuild-from-export step is not run: code/build.py refuses any export other than the pinned one and REPRODUCE.md documents it as optional. Bytes never pass through the coordinator.
